offline.skip_reason: PowerShell runtime unavailable; three script-execution tests were not run.

validation_scope: Strict project-specific subset of AgentPlugins 1.0 and local Cowork candidate shape; authoritative Microsoft and AgentPlugins JSON Schemas and live OAuth were not executed.

public_metadata_observation.source: User-reported public web fetch, 2026-09-24; not a PowerShell live probe

cowork.candidate_builder: Guided offline wizard and explicit flags tested with synthetic publisher inputs; real publisher inputs absent.
cowork.connector_format: Microsoft 365 Unified App Manifest v1.28 candidate, direct Datadog US1 MCP, Cowork-only authorization omitted.
cowork.consent_observation: A Datadog UI showed Limited with 88 read tools and no writes versus Full with 88 reads, 68 writes and sensitive actions; those observed counts may change and do not establish direct Cowork authentication.
cowork.read_only_recommendation: Choose Limited if offered; use a Datadog role with mcp_read and required resource reads without mcp_write.

auth_paths.DCR_first: Cowork-only manifest omits authorization; protected-resource metadata and secret issuance remain unverified.
auth_paths.static_OAuth_conditional: Requires a real Datadog OAuth client, allowlisted Microsoft Teams callback, and an Enterprise token-store auth config plus real OAuthPluginVault reference created by supported Microsoft tooling; none was provisioned.

steps: Activate one Datadog registration in the selected client.
Complete client-managed OAuth with explicit user browser approval.
Confirm MCP initialize and tools/list in the client.
Discover a suitable read-only host tool and its argument schema.
Run one user-approved read-only query for HP11D, if that host belongs to the authorized account.
Restart the client and verify session reuse or normal reauthentication.

unverified: Authenticated connectivity and OAuth registration behavior in each actual client
Actual Datadog tool availability, host presence, resource permissions and network policy
Cursor portable plugin installation through the user's distribution channel
PowerShell script execution on Windows or PowerShell 7
Protected-resource metadata availability; public web fetch exposed no HTTP status
Datadog diagnostic registration issuing a client secret for Microsoft DCR
Cowork publisher metadata, schema validation, tenant upload, OAuth and Information Barriers
Compatibility with, or merge into, the intended destination repository
